module: Terrain quality presets, consumed by graphicsQualityGroup. Each level sets $pref::Terrain::lodScale and $pref::Terrain::detailScale. The onApply hook forces a texture update of all TerrainBlocks.
notes: Levels: Lowest, Low, Normal, High (no Ultra). A smaller lodScale value gives more detail.

qualityLevels.desc: lodScale / detailScale: Lowest 2.0 / 0.5, Low 1.5 / 0.75, Normal 1.0 / 1, High 0.75 / 1.5.

onApply.desc: Called by graphicsQualityGroup when a value has changed. Walks the objects of class TerrainBlock (scenetree.findClassObjects) and calls updateAllTextures() on each one if it exists.
